name: Moonflower
source:
High Alchemist Nika Skylar is an acclaimed alchemist invited as an honoured guest at the Moonfaire. A state held festival to celebrate a rare event of the silver moon. An event that occurs only one every century and fuels the magic of their kingdom for the next hundred years.

During a night of celebration, activity and tradition, tragedy strikes.

A derailed ritual, a murder, a traitor.

Alchemist Skylar must investigate the incident and protect the world's very core of civilization.

The Fabled Moonflower

Accompanied by a princess and a mysterious stranger the clock ticks.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2145530/Moonflower/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
高级炼金术士尼卡·斯凯拉 (Nika Skylar) 是一位备受赞誉的炼金术士，受邀作为月集的贵宾。一个州举办节日来庆祝罕见的银月事件。这一事件每个世纪才发生一次，并在接下来的一百年里为他们的王国增添了魔力。

在一个庆祝、活动和传统的夜晚，悲剧发生了。

一场出轨的仪式、一场谋杀、一个叛徒。

炼金术士斯凯拉必须调查这一事件并保护世界文明的核心。

传说中的月光花

在公主和神秘陌生人的陪伴下，时钟滴答作响。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2145530/Moonflower/]Steam[/url]]
